verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents batch operations explicitly: async crawling up to 25,000 pages with job tracking (context-dev-docs-3, context-dev-docs-34), background batch submission API, and bulk URL discovery via sitemaps (context-dev-docs-5/22). These are accessible programmatically via CLI, SDKs, and MCP for AI-native automation. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of batch job performance at scale, and no explicit bulk operation support for other endpoints like brand/people enrichment beyond single-item calls.
